prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic resort poolside vacation portrait beneath a thatched umbrella.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with fair freckled skin, vibrant red hair in a high messy bun, calm direct gaze and minimal makeup, reclining on a wicker lounge chair wearing a bright red triangle bikini and chunky gold chain necklace with delicate bracelet; natural skin texture and fine-line tattoos visible as in the reference.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait with hand at cheek/temple, legs extended and crossed, wicker chair, thatched umbrella, turquoise pool, beige stucco arches and palms behind; face and upper body sharp.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight with golden-hour influence filtered through straw, gentle shadows and warm peaceful vacation-leisure mood.
prompt.technical_specs: DSLR 50mm look at f/2.8, slight background blur, high-resolution realistic skin, fabric and pool detail, vibrant natural colors.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical ultra-photorealistic resort poolside portrait of one generic approved adult freckled woman with vibrant red hair in a high messy bun, reclining on a wicker lounge chair beneath a thatched umbrella, hand at cheek, wearing a bright red triangle bikini and chunky gold chain necklace with delicate bracelet, legs extended and crossed, turquoise pool, beige stucco arches and palms behind, soft warm natural daylight; preserve visible reference tattoos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit body-part emphasis, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo overlay
